recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce retired Encounter.indication mapping text; any broader HL7 v2 mapping enhancement for procedure reasons or Account billing procedures should be handled as a separate current PA tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-5699 is a Published/Persuasive PA DSTU1 issue requesting Encounter v2 mappings for episodeOfCare (PV1-54/PV1-53), indication (Condition/Procedure aligned with DG1/PRB and PR1), participant/ROL fields, period (PV1-44/PV1-45), and destination (PV1-37).
initial_application: Historical commit 454f90ad94 explicitly tagged Tracker# 5699 and updated the Encounter spreadsheet with the PV1, ROL, period, and destination mappings. The requested Encounter.indication mapping phrase was already present immediately before that commit from 27302910ae, so it was represented in the source lineage even though 454f90ad94 did not modify that row.
additional_context: Current FHIR source keeps Encounter active in source/fhir.ini and uses source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml as the authoritative definition. Later published decisions renamed or reshaped the relevant elements: period is now actualPeriod, participant.individual is participant.actor, destination is admission.destination, FHIR-16148/FHIR-38807 redesigned Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis, FHIR-19285 moved ranked billing diagnosis/procedure data to Account, and FHIR-23764 (already on the combined branch) replaced the stale inherited indication mapping on Encounter.diagnosis.condition with DG1-3.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current StructureDefinition carries the applicable mappings for episodeOfCare, participant, participant.type, participant.period, participant.actor, actualPeriod, reason/diagnosis, and admission.destination, and restoring the old Encounter.indication/DG1-PRB/PR1 wording would conflict with later final PA decisions.
